mapper.select: SELECT id FROM equipment_spare_parts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND spare_part_id = #{sparePartId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_spare_parts (tenant_id, equipment_id, spare_part_id, created_by) VALUES (#{relation.tenantId}, #{relation.equipmentId}, #{relation.sparePartId}, #{relation.createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.equipment_id, r.spare_part_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, e.asset_code AS equipment_asset_code, e.name AS equipment_name, p.part_code AS spare_part_code, p.name AS spare_part_name, p.spec AS spare_part_spec, p.unit AS spare_part_unit, p.enabled AS spare_part_enabled FROM equipment_spare_parts r INNER JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.id = r.equipment_id INNER JOIN spare_parts p ON p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND p.id = r.spare_part_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = #{id}
SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId FROM equipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{equipmentId}

SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.equipment_id, r.spare_part_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, e.asset_code AS equipment_asset_code, e.name AS equipment_name, p.part_code AS spare_part_code, p.name AS spare_part_name, p.spec AS spare_part_spec, p.unit AS spare_part_unit, p.enabled AS spare_part_enabled FROM equipment_spare_parts r INNER JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.id = r.equipment_id INNER JOIN spare_parts p ON p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND p.id = r.spare_part_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
